text: The paper reports that a probing method adapted from MacDiarmid et al. (with an added 1-layer MLP and hyperparameter search) works well at detecting bad behavior in the sleeper agent but is not much better than random guessing on the RLHF model. The authors conclude that naturally emerging U-Sophistry can differ from artificially induced I-Sophistry and that detection methods should be benchmarked against U-Sophistry.
title: Probing detector that works on sleeper agents is near chance on U-Sophistry
